description: Switch Ponytail between Off, Lite, Full, and Ultra in one click, so how hard the agent works matches the task in front of you. A horse button beside the thread composer lists the four modes with a line on what each one does, and keeps the active mode in view. Picking a mode sends the /ponytail command for you, and those commands collapse into compact status pills in the transcript instead of stray slash-command lines. Needs the Ponytail skill installed for the thread's provider, and the control stays disabled until it finds one.
